description: CWE-434 is about the TYPE the caller gets to store, which is exactly why secure_filename does not resolve it: it strips separators so no traversal survives, and preserves the extension untouched. The engine says so rather than staying silent, reporting the sanitizer as INSUFFICIENT for the upload-type context. The negatives are the two shapes that would otherwise flood: a generated destination, and .save() called on a record rather than on an upload.

expected.note: secure_filename addresses the path context and not the type; medium rather than high because the save receiver is untyped, not because the path build is unresolved -- os.path.join reads correctly now
the caller's filename reaches the destination with no transform at all
